command-palette.purpose: Give expert users fast keyboard access to navigation, actions, recent entities, and support tasks without replacing visible navigation.
useWhen: Users need cross-product command access from a stable shortcut or topbar action.
Results combine routes, actions, entities, or help topics with clear grouping.
Commands need permission checks, keyboard navigation, and no-result recovery.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The surface is only a search field without executable actions.
Command execution, permissions, or destructive confirmation is unclear.
The palette hides primary navigation or becomes the only way to complete a task.
foundations: Defines overlay width, result density, grouped layout, and viewport fallback.
Owns command labels, scope labels, empty state, shortcut hints, and result descriptions.
Controls focus, selected result, keyboard target, and action priority.
Palette appears as a bounded overlay above shell content.
Overlay and result updates use system motion and reduced-motion fallback.
Closed, open, typing, selected, loading, no results, disabled, and executing states are explicit.
Requires dialog semantics, labelled search, active descendant or roving focus, Escape close, and focus restoration.
slots: Opens the command palette after user action.
Grouped routes, actions, entities, or help results.
Label, description, type, disabled state, and command owner.
Reports executed command or blocked action.
variants: Routes and recents grouped with keyboard access.
Permissioned commands with confirmation when risk exists.
Empty state gives recovery and support path.
motion: Dialog opens after user action; reduced motion removes decorative movement.
Results update without layout jump or focus loss.
Execution reports success, blocked, or confirmation-required state.
accessibility: Palette opens only after trigger or shortcut.
Keyboard users can move through results and close with Escape.
Disabled or permissioned commands are announced before execution.
No-result state is announced and includes recovery.
tests: Trigger opens the palette and focuses search.
Typing filters results and exposes no-result recovery.
Escape closes the palette and restores focus.
Permissioned command does not execute silently.
Mobile fallback avoids covering critical context without a close path.

canDecide: Use Command Palette when routes/actions and permission rules are defined.
Group results by route, entity, action, or help topic.
Show no-result recovery when search has no match.
mustAsk: Command execution, permissions, analytics, destructive confirmation, or shortcut ownership is unclear.
Commands affect money, access, compliance, or irreversible state.
rejectIf: It is only a visual search box.
Commands execute without permission or confirmation policy.
miel.handoff: Confirm trigger, shortcut, result groups, command execution policy, permission checks, empty state, and feedback.
